 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Narula
 Order

Considering that the instant petition pertains to an FIR registered for the offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and having regard to the fact that the Complainant has expressed her desire to live with her children, the Court considers it apposite to refer the parties to Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre, where they shall appear before the Mediator on 18th August, 2025.
2. On the said date, the parties as well as the children of Petitioner No. 1 and Respondent No. 2 shall appear before the Mediator.
3. List before the Court on 15th October, 2025.
